prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a lively snowy town square. On the left stands a tall lamppost with a golden glow, next to which sits a wooden bench occupied by an old man in a blue coat. A black cat rests on the bench beside him, looking at a red bird perched on the lamp post base. In the center, a woman in a green hat points toward a large snowman wearing a top hat. The snowman has a carrot nose and stands firmly on the white ground. To the right of the snowman, a child in a yellow jacket hands a small shovel to another child in a purple scarf. Behind them, a brown dog runs past a stone fountain that is frozen solid. Near the fountain, a vendor in an apron stands behind a cart selling hot cocoa, handing a cup to a customer in a gray beanie. Above the scene, three distinct clouds float in the pale sky. A street sign on a pole indicates the town name, positioned near the vendor.
